card: census:compare - two evidence files in, the D1 before/after table out, with noise verdicts
deviations_from_card: Critic revision taken as option (b): renderer rounds half up on the decimal value (fixed1), asserted in case 6 (16.45->'16.5', 62.95->'63.0', 55.15->'55.2', 44.55->'44.6'), so case 7's '16.5 -> 63.0' and '55.2% -> 44.6%' hold as the card wrote them (raw toFixed would give 16.4 and 55.1/44.5). No --md flag: output is always the markdown table. census:compare script has no 'npm run data' prefix (reader imports no arena module). Module and its test landed together in the test() commit so each commit is green.
